VERTEX: event_half_span_cm 356.7 - a 315.7 cm muon (8050, pdg 13) blows the native sweep out to a useless scale, so I judged the vertex off the --vtx-span 60 re-capture (shots-vtx/evt170761). At 60 cm the blue star sits cleanly on the apex of a V: the 315.7 cm muon leaves one way (grey, correctly unowned - the reconstruction did NOT put it in a shower) and shower 8026 leaves the other, with the short 8023 (pdg 211) and a green stub also at the apex. Not a vertex failure; the vertex is the best-corroborated thing on this event. VERDICT SHOWER 8026 (206.0 MeV, kine_charge 334.8, 3 segments, pdg 11, len 84.9, start ON the vertex). CONFIDENCE unclear, and here are the two readings I could not separate. Reading A (over-clustered, which is why I set that radio): the member set spans two directions - on shw8026-az+085-el+20 the yellow set is a narrow line with a HARD KINK about 40 cm out, and on az-055-el+65 the two legs project as a hairpin, so this is a real 3-D bend and not one projection's artefact - and it includes 8019, a 9.4 cm segment sitting at 49.0 cm / 53.4 DEG off the axis, admitted by in_main_cluster (walk_add), i.e. by cluster connectivity rather than by any cone gate; 53 deg is outside pass-1's widest step (25 deg) by a factor of two. Reading B: 8026 is a single charged hadron (there IS a pdg 211 shower, 8023, on the same vertex) that hard-scattered at the kink, in which case grouping the two legs is correct and the real error is PID, not clustering. I cannot separate these from the frames: the object is MIP-narrow for essentially its whole 85 cm - the same width as the muon beside it - which argues for a track, but the far end does spray out on az-055-el+20, which argues for a shower. NO MARKS, deliberately: like the pilot's evt280159 I cannot name with confidence which pieces should come out, and 8019 is the only candidate I would even propose. Nothing is MISSING: every unowned segment inside 30 deg is a stub of 0.2-3.2 cm (43046, 30033, 32035, 42045, 31034), so under-clustering is not in play. pi0: showers[].pio_id is -1 and the reconstruction accepted NO group; the capture's auto-slot pairs 8026 + 8049 for a placeholder m = 128.0 MeV on the axis convention, but BOTH start at dist 0.0 from the main vertex so neither can be a converted photon and I store no candidate. Not looked at: the 15 showers the scope rule skipped, all under 20 MeV min_kine_best; of the 3 in scope I opened frames for 8026 only.
